facts.fact: ANSSI's page states that Decree D/2021/092/PRG/SGG, signed 25 March 2021 under Law L/2016/035/AN of 26 July 2016 on electronic transactions, sets rules for electronic transactions including e-commerce (secure transaction facility, .gn or .com domain, prices in francs), names the ARPT as regulator with sanction powers, and provides fines and penalties (the scan itself is image-only, so this is ANSSI's summary).
